item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler over Guangdong today and tomorrow. A band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the coast of southern China midweek this week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Wednesday night. It will become cold over the region in the following couple of days. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather over the coast of southern China will improve gradually during the Lunar New Year holidays. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Wind: Northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches and coastal fog. Bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 18 - 21 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
